title: This Bird Stomps Snakes With 5x Its Body Weight in 15 ms

scenes.text: This bird stomps snakes in fifteen milliseconds.
It's the secretary bird, and it hunts on foot in Africa.
Scientists measured one stomp at 195 newtons, five times its own body weight.
The contact lasts fifteen milliseconds. A blink takes ten times longer.
Its long legs keep its body away from the fangs.
Fifteen milliseconds. Faster than you can blink.

description:
A study published in Current Biology in 2016 measured a secretary bird's stomp at five times its body weight, lasting about 15 milliseconds.
That is about ten times faster than a blink.
Would you rather fight a snake or this bird?
first_comment: Only one captive bird, Madeleine, was measured in the study. What would you name your pet secretary bird?
